thread:
elaine: Heads-up — roadmap sync re: dedicated/reserved pools, burst credits, and autoscale gating. Need to lock launch criteria for the Q3 pilot. Customers need predictable small bursts without surprise preemption.

sam: Can you share specific asks from the pilot customers? which tiers?

elaine: Two customers: fintech (latency-critical, needs SLAs) and a midsize SaaS (cost-sensitive, wants configurable burst). Both want "soft" burst guarantees + clear fallback.

maria: For SLA we should define 99pct P95 latency target + max queued requests window. Also need cost cap per-minute for burst.

deeprak: Tech constraints: GPUs are shared. Hard guarantees = reserved slices; softer guarantees = weighted admission + short prewarm. Autoscale has cooldown of 60s — can we reduce for burst?

jon: Pricing note: customers expect burst to not blow committed spend. Proposal: include limited burst pool (minutes/month) with overage billing and a hard safety cap.

leah: Support + docs ask: show a simple example and a best-effort SLA table. Also add a troubleshooting checklist for when preemption occurs.

elaine: Proposal draft (mini checklist):
```
- Minimum: reserve X GPUs (dedicated pool) for SLA tenant.
- Soft burst: allow Y% of pool for short spikes, tracked as burst credits.
- Fallback: auto-route to cheaper model variant when preempted.
- Autoscale gating: allow canary + immediate fallback; cooldown = 20s for burst only.
- Telemetry: surface per-tenant burst usage & projected exhaustion.
```

maria: Telemetry needs token-level cost + per-token latency histogram. We should also add regression alerts tied to eval prompts.

deeprak: Short cooldown (20s) is doable if we restrict to short bursts and prewarm warm caches. But we need to enforce max KV cache usage per-tenant to avoid OOM.

jon: Commerce ops: define default burst quota (e.g., 15 min/month) and tiers: small/medium/large. Add a manual top-up API for customers.

leah: Ops question: who triages when burst exhausts mid-request? oncall or tenant success?

elaine: Action items: @deepak investigate cache isolation & 20s cooldown risk (due EOD Thu), @maria define telemetry metrics and alerts (EOD Fri), @jon draft pricing bands and top-up flows (Tues), @leah create proto support doc (next Wed).

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly deploy freeze Fri 18:00 UTC — any infra changes related to pool allocation must be queued by Thu 12:00 UTC.

sam: Agree with action items. Quick UX ask: expose burst burn rate in console with projected time-to-exhaust.

elaine: Good point. Add UX item for console expose. I'll take ownership of launch criteria doc and circulate for sign-off by next Tue.

maria: One more note: add an explicit rollback trigger if tail latency regresses >10% after rollout.

elaine: Noted. Thanks all — I'll post the criteria doc shortly and book a 30m follow-up sync. :calendar:
